requirement: a sufficient blade tip clearance with the water surface must be maintained.
scope: Offshore wind turbines, specifically blade tip clearance for growing rotor diameters and increasing machine rating.
source: Implied technical standard for offshore wind turbine design and operation.

requirement: keeping modal frequencies away from wave excitation frequencies.
scope: Offshore wind turbine towers, particularly for large base diameters.
source: Implied technical standard for offshore wind turbine design and structural integrity.
related_domains: structural integrity; design requirements; vibration analysis; hydrodynamics

requirement: Verify the American Bureau of Shipping (ABS) concrete design methodology for FOWTs.
scope: Floating Offshore Wind Turbines (FOWTs) concrete hull structures
related_domains: structural integrity; design standards; materials engineering; certification

requirement: Cable accessories must be compatible with the cable and equipment connected.
scope: Offshore wind farm power cable systems
source: Floating Offshore Wind Turbine Final Report and Technical Summary, Section 4.3.2.4 Cable Accessories
related_domains: electrical systems; component compatibility; offshore wind farm infrastructure

requirement: Equipment must be compatible with the rated voltage of the array and export cables.
scope: Electrical equipment for commercial-scale floating offshore wind farms (FOWFs), including substations, array cables, and export cables.
related_domains: electrical engineering; technical specifications; system integration; offshore wind farm design

requirement: Collisions with neighboring risers and subsea infrastructure are not permissible under any conditions.
scope: Dynamic submarine cables, neighboring risers, and subsea infrastructure in offshore environments (design, installation, and operational phases).
related_domains: operational safety; subsea infrastructure protection; design integrity

requirement: Current BOEM call areas limit water depth to 1,100 meters.

The international guidelines for wind turbine design specify two turbulence models to be used for simulating atmospheric conditions for load calculations: the Mann uniform shear turbulence model, and the Kaimal Spectrum Exponential Coherence (KSEC) model.
scope: Wind turbine design, specifically for simulating atmospheric conditions for load calculations, applicable to floating offshore wind turbines.
source: international guidelines for wind turbine design
related_domains: structural integrity; aerodynamic loads; design standards; simulation and modeling

requirement: Construction of mooring lines and cables in such a way that should a FOWT structure break away from its mooring or is disconnected for maintenance, the mooring lines, and cables sink to the bottom of the ocean rather than float on or near the surface where a marine mammal might encounter them.
scope: Floating Offshore Wind Turbine (FOWT) structures, mooring lines, and cables; applies during construction and maintenance phases; offshore environment.
source: Floating Offshore Wind Turbine Final Report and Technical Summary, Development Assessment Task Order 140M0120F0021
related_domains: environmental protection; marine mammal protection; structural design; operational safety

scope: Ports along the Oregon coast intended for FOWT staging and installation.
source: Musial et al., 2019 (NREL economic feasibility study)

requirement: Ports are unsuitable for FOWT staging and installation if a nearby bridge has a low clearance level.
scope: Newport port, Oregon coast, specifically for FOWT staging and installation.
source: Musial et al., 2019 (NREL economic feasibility study)
